items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: Arnold Loi Canna can tell you all about that. Yeah. He was with the bunch.

ctx.x: And they went on to New York as an act. They worked in Broadville. They flopped in New York. Uh, Arnold Loi Canna can tell you all about that. Yeah. He was with the bunch. Yeah.
And we talked to Ray, uh, Lopez. Ray Lopez. I was clear he told us some of that history and, uh, saw him two years ago in California.
